problems.problem: The regeneration requested by the last accepted patch did not deliver its own prompt: image 1 still shows a tiled stone floor - straight grout seams and per-slab tone patches run under and behind the bottle (vertical seam at approx x390 below the base, horizontal seam at approx y1245), and the enlarged contact crop (image 6) confirms a grout line crossing directly beneath the base. The prompt specifies 'continuous seamless honed pale limestone ground with no tiles and no seams', so the render contradicts its own material spec and the busy seam geometry sits exactly under the hero.

The concept's defining light event is still absent: image 1 shows a uniform cool grey wall and a flat, evenly lit floor with no warm golden caustic pool at the wall-ground junction left of centre and no crisp oblique shadow edge raking the upper wall. Compared with the previous version (image 7) the backdrop is materially unchanged in light story, so the bottle's internal warm glow still has no environmental source and the right-hand type column floats on dead flat grey.

Contact itself is correct and must not be moved: the crop (image 6) shows the base edge meeting the stone with a soft dark contact line and shadow offset_y 0. However, with hard morning sunlight declared, the bottle throws no directional cast shadow and no refracted caustic spill on the ground; the shadow stops at a symmetric contact smear. Reference 4 shows the glass projecting a long luminous directional shadow - the current bottle is placed in the room but not lit by the room's sun.

Product height ratio is 0.35 (bbox y641-1145), the exact floor of the concept's 35-74% safety band; the previous attempt to raise it to 560 px was rejected by geometry validation and never applied. At 35% with the base at y1145 the bottle sits small above roughly 295 px of empty veined foreground that carries no light event, no type and no prop, so the lower third reads under-filled against references 2 and 4 where subject plus light and shadow occupy the field.

The right column is still under-resolved: VERSACE (34 px, tracking 6) at y566 and the 92 px three-line title starting y648 read as two disconnected blocks across a 58 px gap; subtitle and price strings are empty, so the column terminates at the 300 px gold rule at y962 and leaves about 470 px of blank wall and floor below it with no closing element or optical tie to the bottle's base line at y1145.

changes.value: One continuous seamless honed pale limestone ground plane with absolutely no tiles, no grout lines, no seams and no veins, meeting a lime-washed pale cool grey plaster wall at a soft horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame; a single warm golden caustic light pool with refracted filament patterns lying on the ground left of centre at the wall junction; one crisp oblique shadow edge raking the upper wall from the left; fine matte mineral grain, bright cool morning ambient, completely empty scene
